note: Eight scoreboards where the local dot counter and the paid vision model disagreed. The user adjudicated all eight: LOCAL 8/8, PAID 0/8. The paid model answers 2 on 286 of 360 turns, which is a default and not a reading; it also returned an impossible 3 in a live run. The user named the likely mechanism -- the fat middle of the S in DISCARDS reads as an extra dot -- and the pixel scan supports it: everything left of x=202 sits at brightness 194-197 while the reader samples only x=215 and x=241, so the local reader never sees the letters at all.
